candidates.title: Generic ideal-AKN radius-two patch feasibility for the fixed 3/2 periodic certificate
candidates.summary: Exact 576-center census: 286 radius-two full edge-neighbor star patches admit one generic ideal AKN shift; 287 are open-infeasible but closed-feasible and 3 have empty closed intersection. Strict Fourier-Motzkin over Z[tau], with replayed positive-multiplier obstruction proofs; fixed six-axis lift and nonsingular membership only.
candidates.scope: One 3/2 periodic tiling and its 576 centers; no universal claim about radius-two rules, singular boundary selection, or 24-atlas completeness.
